entries.title: 2 Samuel 24:1–12
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: In the way - Which seems added, to shew, how little the example of parents, or ancestors, is to be valued where it is opposed to the will and word of God.

entries.title: 2 Samuel 24:13
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: His father, &c. - Most unhappy parents, that thus help to damn their own children's souls!
